consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1987-04-19 show at Irvine Meadows was a standout performance, particularly praising the energy and musicianship throughout the sets. Many noted the emotional depth of certain songs and highlighted the overall joy of the band during the performance.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 43 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overwhelming enthusiasm and emotional connections expressed by fans, especially first-time attendees, contribute to a strong positive sentiment.
